content: Kasǝki anzong-nzali a nzali Kan'ana
Yahweh bangcau nǝ Musa, ama,
<<Nacau nǝ amǝ Isǝrayila sǝ wu banggia wia ama, <Wun ndo wun nǝ̀ kùtí aɓa nzali Kan'ana, nzali mǝnana nǝ̀ duk ma'wun ace liɓala ka. Amǝnia ka à nda ka anzong ɓá nzalinì, yì nzali Kan'ana:

<< <Nzong-nzali mǝnana a njar-kunmur ka, nǝ̀ nongŋo a bare pǝɗanban Zin mǝnana sárǝ́ arǝ nzong-nzali mala nzali Edom ngga. Nǝ̀ tite nǝ takuli a masǝlǝata Nggeamùr Tuɓamur a buì mǝnana nǝ njar-kunmur ka.
Nǝ̀ lo kano ka nǝ̀ sárǝ́ aban ká Eauwe Akrabbim, nǝ̀ lidǝmba nǝ ká aɓa Pǝɗanban Zin, sǝ nǝ̀ nggá go a Kadesh-Baniya nǝ njar-kunmur. Nǝ̀ lo kano ka, nǝ̀ sarǝa aban ká Hazar-addar, sǝ nǝ̀ bik Azǝmon.
Lo a Azǝmon ngga nzong-nzalinì nǝ̀ kàr aban ká ɓangŋaban nzong-nzali Masar, sǝ nǝ̀ masǝlǝa a Nggeamùr Mediterani.
<< <Nzong-nzali mǝnana a njar-nzali ka, nda kún Nggeamùr Mediterani. Mǝno ka nǝ̀ duk nzong mala nzali ma'wun a njar-nzali.
<< <Nzong-nzali ma'wun a njar-nza ka nǝ̀ lo a kún Nggeamùr Mediterani aban ká Nkono Hor.
Twal kano ka nǝ̀ sarǝa aban ká Lebo-Hamat. Nǝ̀ lidǝmba aban ká a Zedat,
sǝ aban ká Zifǝron, sǝ nǝ̀ masǝlǝa a Hazar-enan. Mǝnia ka nda nzong-nzali ma'wun a njar-nza.
<< <Nzong-nzali ma'wun a njar-takuli ka, nǝ̀ tite a Hazar-enan aban o a Shefam.
Nǝ̀ twal a Shefam sǝ nǝ̀ sarǝa aban ká Ribǝla a njar-takuli mala Ayin. Pǝlǝa nǝ̀ lidǝmba a kusǝ ankono mǝnana a njar-takuli mala Nggeamùr Galili ka.
Nzong-nzali man nǝ̀ sulǝo nǝ̀ yia pǝlǝa a kún Nggeasala Jodan sǝ nǝ̀ nggá masǝlǝa a Nggeamùr Tuɓamur. << <Mǝnia ka nda nǝ̀ duk nzali ma'wun, nǝ anzong-nzali male a koya buì ka.> >>
Pǝlǝa Musa banggi amǝ Isǝrayila ama, <<Mǝnia nda nzali mǝnana wun nǝ̀ gauwi nǝ bwal-shishar ka, yì nzali mana Yahweh pà nzongcau ama ɓǝà pè atau tongno-nong-ine nǝ gauwa-tsùrú mala tàu ka.
Amǝkà Ruben a tàu malea, andǝ amǝkà Gad a tàu malea, andǝ gauwa-tsùrú mala amǝkà Manasa a tàu malea ka, à angŋǝna dǝmba à kumǝna nzali liɓala malea.
Yì atau ɓari andǝ gauwa-tsùrú mala tàu mǝnia ka, à pania wia nzali liɓala malea a nkaring Nggeasala Jodan a nkāɓe Jeriko.>>
Aɓwana-mǝgule mǝnana à nǝ̀ gau nzali ka
Yahweh bangcau nǝ Musa ama,
<<Amǝnia ka, à nda ka alullǝ aburana mǝnana à nǝ̀ gapa wun nzali ace liɓala ka: Eleaza pǝris andǝ Jesǝwa muna-ɓwabura mala Nun.
Sǝ awu nǝ twal múrû mwashat aɓa koya tàu ace bwalia wia arǝ túró gau nzali liɓala.
Amǝnia ka à nda ka alullǝ aburane: <<A tàu mala Yahuda ka, Kalip muna-ɓwabura mala Jefune;
<<A tàu mala amǝkà Shimiyon ngga, Shemuyel muna-ɓwabura mala Ammihud;
<<A tàu mala Benjami ka, Elidad muna-ɓwabura mala Chislon;
<<A tàu mala amǝkà Dan ngga, ɓwamǝgule Bukki, muna-ɓwabura mala Jogǝli;
<<Atà amuna-burana mala Yisǝfu: <<A tàu mala amǝkà Manasa ka, ɓwamǝgule Haniyel, muna-ɓwabura mala Efot;
<<A tàu mala amǝkà Ifǝrem ngga, ɓwamǝgule Kemuyel, muna-ɓwabura mala Shiftan;
<<A tàu mala amǝkà Zebulu ka, ɓwamǝgule Elizafan, muna-ɓwabura mala Parnach;
<<A tàu mala amǝkà Isaka ka, ɓwamǝgule Paltiyel, muna-ɓwabura mala Azzan;
<<A tàu mala amǝkà Asha ka, ɓwamǝgule Ahihud, muna-ɓwabura mala Shelomi;
<<A tàu mala amǝkà Naftali ka, ɓwamǝgule Pedahel, muna-ɓwabura mala Ammihud.>>
Amǝnia ka à nda ka aɓwana mǝnana Yahweh tsǝa ama ɓǝà gau nzali liɓala amur amǝ Isǝrayila aɓa nzali Kan'ana ka.
